comparison.objective: Align a long blanking panel with both U6 rack holes, push both clips home, and release it; the candidate adjusts a robot gripper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual long-part alignment and simultaneous two-peg insertion versus coaxial driver/wrench seating and torque control.
comparison.success_condition: Requires correct rack-unit placement, both ends home, and released dwell; candidate requires a locked 90° stop retained over three cycles.
comparison.reason: Both are relevant to AI infrastructure, but domain membership and release checks do not make rack-panel insertion equivalent to stop calibration and jam-nut locking.
